title: KataBot
tagline: AI-powered MPC server for NFT, wallets, transfers, and analytics
description:
This project is an AI-powered MPC server that allows users to manage cryptocurrency and NFT assets securely. Through a natural language chatbot interface, users can query wallet balances, transaction histories, and transfer tokens without exposing private keys, thanks to multi-party computation (MPC). It integrates with OpenSea to provide NFT data, making it easy for collectors and traders to access ownership records, listings, and transfer details instantly through AI-driven interactions.
Additionally, a custom MPC server built for the Katana protocol provides in-depth analytics and insights for smart contracts and NFT activity. The system tracks top senders and receivers, analyzes transaction patterns, and exposes key contract information, all through a single AI agent. By combining MPC’s privacy-preserving computations with AI’s intuitive query handling, the platform delivers a secure, intelligent, and user-friendly interface for blockchain asset management and analytics across multiple NFT ecosystems.
how_its_made: We built an AI-powered MPC platform using React, TailwindCSS, TypeScript, Python, OpenAI, n8n, and dynamic MPC frameworks for OpenSea and Katana. The frontend chatbot handles natural language queries, while the backend securely manages wallet operations and NFT analytics. A custom Katana MPC server analyzes transactions and smart contracts, and a hacky but effective trick was dynamically generating query pipelines on-the-fly for flexible, multi-step workflows.
